headline: Tencent's hy4-flash sets an all-time token-share record at 45.1%, and nobody's catching it soon
summary: tencent/hy4-flash-20261116 took rank 1 with 45.1% of tokens, a fresh all-time high for a single model. Tencent as a provider now holds 46.6%, and the top two providers together sit at 69.9%, so this is less a leaderboard than a Tencent-and-DeepSeek duopoly with Zhipu AI hovering nearby.
highlights: tencent/hy4-flash-20261116 is at 45.1% of tokens, the highest all-time token share on record.
Tencent's provider share is 46.6% today, up 37.3 points over the past seven days.
Tencent, DeepSeek, and Zhipu AI together hold 74.4% of tokens.
google/gemini-4-carbon-20261110 climbed six places in a day to 20th.
stepfun/step-5-preview-20261008 dropped out after last ranking 24th.
